premises.text: People planning nights out need what places and events go together for their occasion, not just isolated restaurant/bar/concert finders
premises.evidence_span: there's not a single product on the market today that can tell you what places and what events go together for your occasion

premises.text: Plans are generated from mood, companions, optional focal events, and review snippets, including Facebook-profile personalization
premises.evidence_span: What's my mood and who's coming with me?

premises.text: WIATA algorithmically classifies, ranks, and composes places and events from across the web into real-time itineraries that are never hand-curated
premises.evidence_span: algorithmically classifying them, ranking them, and on the fly, composing them into itineraries

premises.text: Friends can advise and edit plans in real time via Facebook notifications
premises.evidence_span: They all get a Facebook notification saying I've asked them for some advice on my WeOtta plan

premises.text: Completed plans convert into Facebook events with places, booking links, and invites in seconds
premises.evidence_span: making a Facebook event on WIATA is that it's even easier than making a Facebook event on Facebook site itself

value.text: Hassle-free answer to what to do tonight with composed, relevant plans
value.evidence_span: solves the problem of what to do tonight. It also takes all the hassle out of planning it
